entries.en: to command; to order; to send (someone)
entries.notes: 本条为 mandar 总目；H 栏「律」（律令）与音写 luỹ 不尽相合，疑为引出「律令」义的引字。

entries.en: 〔damaged in original; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: L 栏词组破碎（mandar hacienda señal），H 栏 釣/鈞 与音写 unì jin 无法对应，四栏不能互证。

entries.zh: 票单；凭票领取的凭证；传票
entries.en: ticket; chit; voucher for collection; written pass
entries.notes: 音写多处 T99 污损，句中 quotber 疑为 cobrar（收取），末「pay giã」与第 21 条重出，H 栏「票」可辨而整条语义只能推定。

entries.en: to command; to order; a command
law; ordinance; rule; established custom
entries.notes: 音写「huân toũ-luy / luâ-huân luy」当作「法度理」一类，指法度规矩，非单字「法」义。

entries.zh: 唱歌；歌唱（原文西语词头与汉字栏不合，释义存疑）
entries.en: to sing; singing (Spanish headword does not match the Chinese column)
entries.notes: H 栏「歌」与 M 栏所夹西语 cantar（唱）互证为歌唱，然 L 栏「de la ley natural」完全不合，疑栏位错行或原件污损。

entries.en: royal decree; the king's command
entries.notes: [疑:㫖/旨] 仅为异体之别，音写 chỹ 与「旨」相应，语义由 mandar del Rey 定。

entries.en: an order; a command (from a superior)
law; statute; the Law
order of a superior; directive

entries.zh: 下达命令；命下（上命下传）
entries.en: to hand down an order; a command issued downward
entries.notes: [疑:命下/命令]，音写 beng he 之 he 对应「下」，故取「命下」。

entries.en: command; order
esteemed command; a superior's directive (honorific)
entries.notes: [疑:鈞/釣]，音写 quin 对应「鈞」，非「釣」，此条为对上官命令的敬称。

entries.en: to entrust; to enjoin; to instruct
to deliver the royal edict (to a place); to carry a decree
entries.notes: [疑:詔/訃]，音写 chiau 支持「詔」，全条为送旨到某处。

entries.en: royal edict; decree of the king
entries.notes: [疑:詔/訃]，音写 chiau 支持「詔」。

entries.en: imperial rescript; edict
entries.notes: 「勅」为「敕」之异体，音写 sit 与之相应。

entries.zh: 诫勉；告诫（命人向善做好）
entries.en: to admonish; an exhortation (to do well)
entries.notes: [疑:誡/警]，音写 cai bien 当作「诫勉」，H 栏「免」疑为「勉」之省。

entries.en: judicial writ; warrant; summons
entries.notes: 「照身」指验明身份之文书，此处与 mandato judicial 对，义近令状。

entries.en: to receive a command; to be under orders
entries.notes: [疑:春/奉]，音写 hong beng 当作「奉命」；L 栏「Decesa prae」疑为拉丁文缩写或残损。

entries.en: warrant of arrest; official warrant (牌票)
entries.notes: p⁴ 为 para 之缩写，全条即「捕人之令」。

entries.en: warrant; ticket; permit
